description: Infiniti Oracle is the AI-native market intelligence layer for prediction markets. This feed publishes hourly briefings on Polymarket, Kalshi and beyond — major market movements, volume records, regulatory and legal developments, new notable markets, and high-signal political, economic and crypto predictions — plus live commodities and crypto stats blocks tracking gold, oil, natural gas and BTC/ETH/SOL price action.

items.title: Kalshi probes suspicious trades on Trump's press secretary pick
items.summary: Kalshi has opened an investigation after the WSJ found at least three small but well-timed wagers on conservative commentator Katie Zacharia being named White House press secretary, placed before the NYT reported the pick at ~2 p.m. ET Friday; a $19 bet placed ~10:43 p.m. Thursday is slated to pay $1,896, and two Friday bets ($74, $80) expect $3,689 and $4,023. Zacharia had been priced near 1% on Kalshi; Trump confirmed the appointment in a Truth Social post Friday afternoon .

items.title: Norway moves to block Kalshi, Polymarket and 60 other unlicensed sites
items.summary: The Norwegian Gaming Authority notified 62 companies that their sites could face DNS blocking for serving Norwegian consumers in breach of gambling law; the regulator has already blocked 238 gambling sites, and companies have until Oct 15 to respond before a final decision .

items.title: Vol on Tennessee vs Arkansas: markets love the Vols but split on details
items.summary: Polymarket and Kalshi both price No. 15 Tennessee at 83% to beat Arkansas on Saturday; Kalshi has $56,245 traded on the game as of Friday, less than 6% of the Texas game, and the QB-news move hit first-quarter markets (-7 pts on the Vols) while the winner contract hasn't moved all week .

items.title: Kalshi's tribal prediction-app push details: four ventures named
items.summary: Oklahoma's PokkeTrades (Alabama-Quassarte), Greenville Rancheria's Greenville, Alturas Indian Rancheria's AIR Markets, and Kletsel Dehe's Sovereign Edge; each venture owns its app and branding while Kalshi provides trade matching, clearing, custody and surveillance .

items.title: FCA confirms UK entry talks as prediction markets push back on gambling label
items.summary: FCA markets chief Simon Walls confirmed the regulator is discussing potential UK entry with prediction-market operators (Oct 6); the FCA's 2026 perimeter report classified the financial prediction-market products it examined as binary options still subject to the 2019 retail ban .

items.title: Iowa Senate toss-up: Hinson 54–56¢ on both platforms
items.summary: Prediction markets price Ashley Hinson vs Josh Turek as a near toss-up for the open Senate seat: Polymarket Hinson 54¢ / Turek 46¢, Kalshi Hinson 56¢ / Turek 44¢ .

items.title: Kalshi launches prediction apps with Native American tribes, dividing Indian country

items.title: CNN: midterm "mention markets" fuel insider-trading alarms
items.summary: A new CNN investigation reports prediction sites now offer an average of 44 granular markets per race, and Kalshi has suspended at least six 2026 candidates this year for betting on their own races; the piece revisits the summer case of Trump's White House teleprompter operator settling an insider-trading probe for $65,000 over "mention markets" in Trump speeches. Kalshi's head of enforcement says screening for irregular activity is continuous; Polymarket hired a former FBI official and says it regularly refers cases to the DOJ .

items.title: Polymarket signs with the Rangers; NHL remains the only league aboard

The NHL is still the only major sports league formally partnered with prediction-market platforms; the NFL, MLB and NBA have stayed away while CNBC and CNN integrate market data .

items.title: Torres formally introduces insider-trading bill Friday, backed by Pelosi
items.summary: The Public Integrity in Financial Prediction Markets Act of 2026 was introduced with 30+ Democratic co-sponsors including former Speaker Nancy Pelosi, Rep. Andre Carson and Rep. Rashida Tlaib; it bars federal elected officials, appointees, executive staff and congressional aides from trading event contracts tied to government action when holding or able to reasonably obtain material nonpublic information. Torres: "all the hallmarks of potential insider trading." Kalshi says it already prohibits MNPI-based trading .

items.title: Senate version from Merkley/Klobuchar; Murphy bill coming too
items.summary: Sens. Merkley and Klobuchar's companion proposal would bar government officials from trading prediction markets and strengthen the CFTC's power to go after bad actors, citing the ~$400k Maduro-contract win and similar suspect Iran-linked trades; last month Israeli authorities brought securities charges over Polymarket trades on Iran military actions. Sen. Murphy (D-CT) plans his own bill this month targeting "mention" markets on government actions, while leaving economic derivatives untouched .

items.title: Iowa Senate: markets still back Hinson despite fresh polling
